0022600124.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-1, 1-0 at home, 0-1 on the road, 8th in the West) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 2-0 at home, 1st in the Northwest), who have won all three of their games and enter on a three-game winning streak. The Suns are without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), while the Thunder are missing Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (ankle), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Suns lost 2-3 to the Thunder in the 2025-26 regular season and lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, with the most recent meeting a 131-122 Thunder win in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
